insights.summary: A successful run where the agent applied standard Python performance best practices to a complex codebase. It demonstrated good knowledge of Python internals.
strengths: Strong knowledge of Python-specific performance pitfalls.
Excellent adherence to complex workflow constraints.
weaknesses: Relied on 'best practice' optimizations rather than data-driven profiling.
Limited exploration of the core C++/CUDA kernels which often drive vLLM performance.
